name: Zambry Abd Kadir
_note: M2 full-cabinet completion: Minister of Higher Education since 3 Dec 2022. Objective spine plus a provisional Layer B pass on file; below ranking validity pending remaining objective dimensions and an independent Layer B panel. Layer B (Editorial Panel) is a SINGLE-CODER provisional first-coder pass (coderScores length 1): each score is recorded and cited but NOT scored, normalized, or ranked, per methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3. Citations verified to exist via search; article full text was not opened (environment fetch restriction), so facts rest on cross-outlet-corroborated search summaries and require primary-source reconfirmation before any independent panel finalizes the score.

metrics.justification: No personal corruption or criminal matter of record. The only litigation of record is the 2009-2010 Nizar v Zambry constitutional dispute over the Perak Menteri Besar position, resolved in his favour by the Federal Court, which is not an integrity or anti-corruption matter.

metrics.justification: Crisis response to the 9 Jun 2025 Gerik bus crash that killed 15 UPSI students: coordinated victim aid and family accommodation, donated one month's salary, and announced (11 Jun 2025) that the PTPTN loans of the 13 deceased borrowers were fully settled with a death benefit to each family. Rapid, measurable response, one later hostel-death case still under investigation (anchor 3).

citation.title: Gerik bus crash: PTPTN loans of 13 UPSI students killed in accident fully settled, says Zambry

metrics.justification: The University and University Colleges Act (AUKU/UUCA) amendments he tabled were passed (18 Mar 2024) and gazetted, easing some student-association and disciplinary rules, but retained the centralised control structure critics wanted removed; a broader higher-education legal framework remained aspirational. Partial reform with material dilution (anchor 2).

citation.title: Dewan Rakyat passes AUKU amendment bill

metrics.justification: The AUKU amendments followed engagement sessions with student groups since 2021 and passed by voice vote, but no durable new cross-bench or institutional instrument was created and student groups disputed the consultation's adequacy. Worked within process without clearly strengthening an institution (anchor 2).

citation.title: Dewan Rakyat passes amendments to varsities Act

metrics.justification: Said on 26 Jan 2026 the government had "no plans to repeal AUKU in its entirety," then after a 9 Feb 2026 student march said the ministry was "open to reviewing" it. The stance softened under pressure within about two weeks, without a clear on-record acknowledgement that it was a reversal (anchor 2).
